project.title: I Grandi Oggetti
project.description: 3D animated short inspired by The Big Lebowski.
project.introText: A 3D animated short that retells the Coen brothers' The Big Lebowski through its objects. It is conceived as a trailer, with the surreal atmosphere of David Lynch and the visual style of Wes Anderson.
project.middleText: Made with Jessica Bugamelli and Laura Martorana as the final project of the 300-hour 3D Animation course run by Demetra Formazione with the Future Film Festival in 2023, co-funded by the European Social Fund+ and Regione Emilia-Romagna. The course covered 3D modelling and animation in Blender and Autodesk Maya.
